item.title: New complex housing the Prime Minister
item.description: The upcoming complex that will house the Prime Minister's Office is set to be named 'Seva Teerth'. The new complex, designed as part of the Central Vista redevelopment project, is expected to bring several key offices under one roof to streamline coordination at the highest levels of government.

item.title: Le Bal des Débutantes 2025: Jinnah
item.description: Ella Wadia delivered a standout fashion moment at Le Bal des Débutantes 2025 in Paris, appearing in a sculpted Elie Saab couture gown that instantly drew global attention.

item.title: A blouse worth Rs 80 lakh? Coimbatore designer
item.description: Coimbatore designer Sonia Ravikumar has created an Rs 80 lakh gold blouse using 750g gold and precious stones. She also unveiled a silver Navaratna piece worth up to Rs 10 lakh.

item.title: Hardik Pandya plays explosive knock on return from injury, helps Baroda beat mighty Punjab
item.description: Hardik Pandya marked his first match since a quadriceps injury with an unbeaten 77 off 42, steering Baroda to a successful chase of 223 against Punjab. Despite an expensive bowling spell, his late partnership finished the job with nine balls remaining.

item.title: Rameshwaram Cafe owners booked over worm in food at Bengaluru airport outlet, fake extortion case
item.description: A man, who visited the cafe before boarding a flight to Guwahati, had claimed that an insect was found in the food served popular South Indian restaurant chain, Rameshwaram Cafe, at its Bengaluru Airport outlet.

item.title: Mumbai pod-taxi plan gathers speed, bhoomi pujan for Mira-Bhayandar route in six months: Check details
item.description: Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis emphasised that pod taxi services would soon be introduced in the state to give a boost to mobility and simultaneously reduce congestion.

item.title: OnePlus Pad Go 2 to launch in India on December 17 with Dimensity 7300, 5G and Stylus support: Full details
item.description: OnePlus has confirmed that the OnePlus Pad Go 2 will launch in India on December 17 alongside the OnePlus 15R. The tablet will feature a 12.1-inch 2.8K display, a MediaTek Dimensity 7300 chipset, 5G support, 8GB RAM, 256GB storage, and stylus compatibility.

item.title: Allahabad High Court order UP to verify SC status of converted individuals
item.description: The court also cited Supreme Court rulings, including Soosai, KP Manu, and C Selvarani, which held that claiming SC benefits after conversion is not allowed and defeats the purpose of reservation.

item.title: Robin Smith, former England cricketer, dies aged 62; teammate breaks into tears
item.description: Former England batter Robin Smith died at 62 in Perth. Teammate Kevan James confirmed the news. Smith, a standout from the 1980s–90s, had an illustrious career for England and Hampshire and had spoken openly about his post-retirement mental health struggles.
